data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why did Aaron Rodgers claim he was immunized against COVID when he never got vaccinated? ASSISTANT:
aron Rodgers was likely referring to being immunized against other illnesses and did not mean to imply that he was vaccinated against COVID-19.
